panels.description: Current logical incidents in new or acknowledged state, filtered by incident creation time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS OpenIncidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status IN ('new', 'acknowledged') AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1))

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS OpenCrossSource FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status IN ('new', 'acknowledged') AND source_family_count > 1 AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids))

panels.title: Open cross-source incidents

panels.description: Persisted exact unevaluated-input counts from the latest scheduling state for the selected correlation rule. This is not a live ledger anti-join.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUInt64(ifNull(sum(unevaluated_input_count), 0)) AS UnevaluatedInputs FROM fusion.correlation_schedule_state_current WHERE (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id))

panels.title: Correlation backlog

panels.description: Maximum persisted age of the oldest unevaluated input. A drained scope displays 0 seconds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toFloat64(ifNull(max(oldest_unevaluated_age_seconds), 0.0)) AS OldestUnevaluatedAgeSeconds FROM fusion.correlation_schedule_state_current WHERE (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id))

panels.description: Incident creation volume. This panel uses created_at, not last_seen.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, severity, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time, severity

panels.title: Incidents created over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY incidents DESC, severity

SELECT incident_type, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY incident_type ORDER BY incidents DESC, incident_type

SELECT primary_host AS host, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND primary_host != '' AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY primary_host ORDER BY incidents DESC, host LIMIT 15

SELECT primary_user AS user, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND primary_user != '' AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY primary_user ORDER BY incidents DESC, user LIMIT 15

SELECT technique, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current ARRAY JOIN mitre_technique_ids AS technique WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) GROUP BY technique ORDER BY incidents DESC, technique LIMIT 20

SELECT correlation_rule_id, count() AS incidents FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND source_family_count > 1 AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) GROUP BY correlation_rule_id ORDER BY incidents DESC, correlation_rule_id

SELECT created_at AS Created, last_seen AS LastSeen, severity AS Severity, status AS Status, incident_type AS Type, correlation_rule_id AS CorrelationRule, primary_host AS Host, primary_user AS User, source_family_count AS SourceFamilies, detection_count AS Detections, event_count AS ContextEvents, incident_id AS IncidentID FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND source_family_count > 1 AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, incident_id LIMIT 250

panels.description: Current confirmation-backed incident revisions. Dashboard time filters this table by last_seen; summary panels use created_at.

targets.rawSql: SELECT last_seen AS LastSeen, created_at AS Created, updated_at AS Updated, severity AS Severity, status AS Status, incident_type AS Type, incident_title AS Title, primary_host AS Host, primary_user AS User, correlation_rule_id AS CorrelationRule, arrayStringConcat(mitre_technique_ids, ', ') AS MITRE, input_count AS Evidence, incident_id AS IncidentID FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen) AND (has([${status:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${status:sqlstring}], status)) AND (has([${severity:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${severity:sqlstring}], severity)) AND (has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${incident_type:sqlstring}], incident_type)) AND (has([${host:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${host:sqlstring}], primary_host)) AND (has([${user:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${user:sqlstring}], primary_user)) AND (has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], '.*') OR has([${correlation_rule:sqlstring}], correlation_rule_id)) AND (has([${tactic:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${tactic:sqlstring}], item), mitre_tactic_ids)) AND (has([${technique:sqlstring}], '.*') OR arrayExists(item -> has([${technique:sqlstring}], item), mitre_technique_ids)) AND (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'all' OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'yes' AND source_family_count > 1) OR (${cross_source:sqlstring} = 'no' AND source_family_count <= 1)) ORDER BY last_seen DESC, incident_id LIMIT 500

panels.title: Current incidents (filtered by last seen)

panels.description: Select an exact IncidentID from the current-incidents table to inspect its confirmation-backed state. Correlation confidence is rule-declared, not a probability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT incident_id AS IncidentID, incident_title AS Title, incident_type AS Type, status AS Status, severity AS Severity, confidence AS CorrelationConfidence, first_seen AS FirstSeen, last_seen AS LastSeen, primary_host AS Host, primary_user AS User, primary_source_ip AS SourceIP, primary_destination_ip AS DestinationIP, detection_count AS Detections, event_count AS ContextEvents, source_family_count AS SourceFamilies, arrayStringConcat(mitre_tactic_ids, ', ') AS Tactics, arrayStringConcat(mitre_technique_ids, ', ') AS Techniques, correlation_rule_id AS CorrelationRule, correlation_rule_version AS RuleVersion, episode_anchor_kind AS AnchorKind, episode_anchor_id AS AnchorID FROM fusion.incidents_current WHERE ${incident_id:sqlstring} != '.*' AND incident_id = ${incident_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY incident_id LIMIT 100

panels.title: Selected incident detail

panels.description: Deterministic evidence order is occurrence time, input kind, then stable input ID. Visibility time makes late arrival observable. Snapshots are bounded and exclude raw payloads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS Occurred, observed_at AS Observed, input_kind AS InputKind, input_id AS InputID, relationship AS Relationship, source_type AS SourceType, rule_id AS RuleID, if(input_kind = 'detection', rule_name, event_action) AS RuleOrAction, event_category AS EventCategory, outcome AS Outcome, service_name AS Service, severity AS Severity, host_name AS Host, user_name AS User, source_ip AS SourceIP, destination_ip AS DestinationIP, arrayStringConcat(mitre_technique_ids, ', ') AS MITRE, summary AS Summary FROM fusion.incident_timeline WHERE ${incident_id:sqlstring} != '.*' AND incident_id = ${incident_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY occurred_at, input_kind, input_id LIMIT 500
